title: Bind authoritative Search+Telemetry owners to read-only Event Inspection HTTP
goal: Offer an embeddable first-party HTTP handler returning the canonical CAP-INV-004 projection to the existing browser transport shape, only after independently server-verified session, Search Job selection and telemetry/raw/rendered authorization.
invariants: Read-only single-Event inspection only; no Case/Artifact/Evidence link, export, mutation, pivot execution, new parser/index/IAM engine, storage or supplier selection
Host session supplies principal tenant environment; POST JSON is only a selector, never permissions or decision inputs
Existing first-party Event Inspection Project performs core read permission and raw/rendered separation; do not duplicate that engine
Search owner independently verifies selected Event membership in authorized Job/run; Telemetry owner independently verifies Event/tenant/environment, read and per-field classification
Only the already redacted field set from the Telemetry owner may be projected; host must deliver production identity, authorization, audit, TLS, CSRF protection and source adapters
No direct edit to reviewed PR #181,#182,#183 or their branches; no production readiness claims
security_properties: Fail-closed if host session unavailable or tenant/environment mismatch; never infer client permission from eventRef/sourceHint
Deny before telemetry access if Search selection not independently authorized
Deny if Telemetry owner refuses or returns wrong EventRef/tenant or invalid raw/rendered decisions
Raw denied produces no raw bytes and no raw-derived sensitive field values; rendered may independently remain allowed
Malformed, unbounded, cross-scope, stale, canceled or unknown requests never receive protected partial results
No permissive CORS; content-type is application/json; no-store, nosniff; no client-supplied session source

migration.rationale: Host-injected read-only HTTP adapter; no schema or persistence

rollback.strategy: Revert bounded host adapter while retaining existing Event Inspection core and all reviewed PR snapshots
verification: Event Inspection core module tests unchanged
No class-2 or production IAM claim

inputs: CAP-INV-004/002 full canonical read-only transition and Shared Telemetry Event ownership
Verified E10-INV-004E Go projector on foundation #36
Existing frontend inspection transport schema on isolated #183 (not modified)
outputs: New embeddable authorized HTTP handler composing distinct SessionResolver, SearchOwner, TelemetryOwner and existing eventinspection.Project
Server response compatible with JS Inspector normalization: lowerCamel source/parser/enrichments; independent raw/rendered variants
HTTP httptest security matrix including host spoof, source redaction, denied raw, malformed requests, wrong Event and partial stale provenance
Exact-HEAD cross-platform CI evidence, with explicit exclusion of real host and production
acceptance_tests: Positive real HTTP request passes server-source authorization chain and returns browser-compatible read-only projection
Denial at Search stage never invokes Telemetry owner; owner/identity mismatch yields generic denied and zero protected bytes
Raw and rendered independent; denied raw causes zero leakage of source-owned raw-derived secret
Invalid Event origin/provenance, malformed/oversize JSON, unsupported method/content-type fail closed
Go race/test/vet and host coverage >=90% on exact commit; full adaptive engineering checks required separately
definition_of_ready: Authorization provider contracts independent and read-only; no Class-2 mutation required
definition_of_done: Publish handler and tests on GitHub in authorized paths
Node schema parity demonstrated by canonical field names and direct regression
Exact-SHA CI and security checks completed; L2 review separate for material owner boundary

performance_budget.rationale: In-process httptest transport contract only; live event source, latency and SLO not selected
